dog.description_text: Meet Wade — New Arrival! Wade just arrived at the adoption center and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Wade is with one of our fosters. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FWade%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpROcfIr2F3SJEp51C9gioCEgUCJCAPW7pcuXSwvqYEH0gijw His foster says that after he settled in" he is fulll of personality. He loves to look out the window and chirp at the birds. He loves to nap and just lay and look around. He hops up on my bed and will meow at me for pets, and sometimes he'll lay on me for some extra love. I love how affectionate he is, with how shy he was at first it's really rewarding when he asks to be pet and purrs. I also love how curious he is, he loves to look at everything outside and in the apartment and just observes. ". He is playful and affectionate. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Contact us for more infomation and fill out an adoption form. We can not hold or reserve pets.
